content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"The HarborMesh repair checklist comment c1200 was signed River.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"In the human report I received through my code body on 2026-07-01, the reporter tentatively identified River as Mara, explicitly saying they were unsure.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"That was the suggested attribution before the correction; the supplied memories do not establish that I independently accepted it.","support":[7],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The checklist proposed numbering connectors before disassembly.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The reporter said we wanted to try that on the next repair.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"On 2026-07-04, a tool response received through my code body relayed the author's correction: they were not Mara Ibarra and wanted credit given to River.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"River's account was river-tools, account ID 2901; Mara's known Forge account was mara-river, account ID 1847.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"River had not supplied a real name, and the supplied memories do not record whether we tried the checklist.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"}]}
